attributes.description: Sum of tokens.total over every model call in the selection (parent and subagent sessions).
attributes.title: Tokens

attributes.description: Wall-clock span of the selected records (whole-second recorder timestamps).
attributes.title: Elapsed (first → last record)

attributes.description: Sum of api_duration_ms (model call latency, including failed calls).
attributes.title: Model time

attributes.description: Sum of duration_ms of completed tool calls. delegate_task returns when the subagent is launched, so subagent work shows in the child session's own model/tool time.
attributes.title: Tool time

attributes.description: API errors (api_request_error) plus tool calls whose status is not ok.
attributes.title: Failed steps

attributes.description: Model API attempts made after a failed attempt (pre_api_request with retry_count > 0).
attributes.title: Retries

attributes.description: Share of records that passed the exporter's (provisional) ingest verify. Anomaly records count as failures. Authoritative check: atp_cli.py verify.
attributes.title: Verify pass rate

attributes.description: Vega. Parent session → child subagent sessions via parent_session_id (plus parent_turn_id / parent_subagent_id in the tooltip). Size = tokens, colour = model + tool ms, red ring = a failed step, dashed = parent outside the current selection.
attributes.title: Session tree (parent → subagent sessions)

attributes.description: Vega-Lite. One bar per completed model/tool step, rows by session start then seq.
attributes.title: Step waterfall

attributes.description: One row per ATP record, sorted by session_id then seq, so each session reads top to bottom like a transcript.
attributes.title: Hermes ATP steps (session, seq)

attributes.description: One request end to end: the parent Hermes session and the subagent sessions it delegated to (session tree), every model and tool step on a timeline (waterfall), the records in order (step table) and rollups. Pick a session or turn at the top. Ingest-time verify is provisional; run atp_cli.py verify for the verdict.
attributes.title: Hermes ATP request lifecycle
